source.description:
## PROBLEM
This workstation is always-dev: global xt/xtrm/sp/specialists commands must use local default-branch builds rather than wait for npm publication. The current globals are restored package copies and do not contain the accepted candidate bytes.

## SUCCESS
After Core and Specialists integration PRs merge, both repositories are updated to exact merged default-branch heads, built, and linked through the Node v24.15.0 global package/bin locations. Real shell commands resolve to those local main builds and survive a new shell.

## SCOPE
Local main checkout updates, documented project builds, npm/global package links or the existing repository-native link mechanism, bin links, version/hash capture, and rollback metadata.

## NON_GOALS
No npm publish/tag. No links to temporary validation worktrees or feature branches. No modification of unrelated global tools.

## CONSTRAINTS
Wait for both integration merges. Snapshot existing package trees and links before replacement. Keep a rollback command. Link only canonical local main checkouts. Preserve user config and global skills.

## VALIDATION
- [ ] xt/xtrm resolve to the Core local-main build.
- [ ] sp/specialists resolve to the Specialists local-master build.
- [ ] Runtime hashes match freshly built merged heads.
- [ ] New-shell smoke passes.
- [ ] Rollback metadata is complete.

## LIBRARIES
Reuse npm link or the repositories existing local-link workflow; no new dependency.

## OUTPUT
Exact merged heads, build commands, link targets, hashes, new-shell smoke, and rollback instructions.
source.title: dev-runtime: link global commands to local main builds
